Sealer

nombres.presentacion_subs: Subs who show up on the agreed day
nombres.pagos_sin_aprobacion: Sub payments without work approved by the PM
nombres.no_calidad_sobre_contratos: Cost of poor quality over contracts

explicaciones.tasa_cierre_dia: The integrity of your data. If it drops, everything else is fiction.
explicaciones.cumplimiento_semanal: Of what was planned to finish last week, how much was finished.
explicaciones.avisos_fuera_de_sla: If you fail here, the PM stops reporting.
explicaciones.horas_respuesta_avisos: Your commitment to the PM, measured.
explicaciones.presentacion_subs: The real quality of your sub bench.
explicaciones.pagos_sin_aprobacion: If you pay without approval, quality control falls apart.
explicaciones.saldo_subcontratistas: What you already owe even if it has not left your account.
explicaciones.inspecciones_con_defectos: Found in time, before being covered. It is good that this exists.
explicaciones.pruebas_agua_con_fuga: Each one avoided is the most expensive warranty claim there is.
explicaciones.punch_por_obra: Above the goal: the pre-handover inspection is not being done.
explicaciones.punch_en_7_dias: Closing late is what ruins a handover that went well.
explicaciones.garantias_por_obra: What slipped through. It mirrors quality.
explicaciones.resenas: Your client acquisition cost drops directly with this.
explicaciones.oc_fuera_de_sla: Job days you are losing while waiting.
explicaciones.oc_autorizadas: Below the goal: you quote high or communicate poorly.
explicaciones.margen_oc: If it is lower than the contract, you are giving work away.
explicaciones.oc_sobre_contratos: Above the goal, the problem is in your estimate.
explicaciones.no_calidad_sobre_contratos: The metric that hurts and almost nobody measures.

plan.estaSemana: {n, plural, =0 {This week's plan doesn't expect anything to finish yet.} one {This week's plan is saved: # task to finish.} other {This week's plan is saved: # tasks to finish.}}
plan.ver: See what was promised last week: {hechas} of {total} finished
plan.sinPlan: No plan was saved last week. It saves itself the first time you open the app in the week.

indicadores.verObras: {n, plural, one {See the job} other {See the # jobs}}

detalle.tasa_cierre_dia: {n, plural, one {# day not closed: {dias}} other {# days not closed: {dias}}}
detalle.avisos_fuera_de_sla: {n, plural, one {# alert not answered in time} other {# alerts not answered in time}}
detalle.oc_fuera_de_sla: {n, plural, one {# change order awaiting the client} other {# change orders awaiting the client}}
detalle.cargos_sin_recibo: {n, plural, one {# charge without receipt · {monto}} other {# charges without receipt · {monto}}}

miEmpresa.ayuda: Your company's logo and color: your team installs the app on their phone with them, and the logo shows at the top of every screen and in your clients' portal.
miEmpresa.vistaPreviaAyuda: This is how the icon will look on your team's phone.
miEmpresa.logo: Logo (PNG or JPG, up to 1 MB)
miEmpresa.logoAyuda: Use a square image: it fills the whole icon, with no margin (if it isn't square, it's cropped to the center). PNG or JPG up to 1 MB. Without a logo, the icon shows the company's initials.
miEmpresa.instalarAyuda: If someone already installed the app, to see the new icon: on iPhone, remove it from the home screen and add it again; on Android it updates by itself, though it can take a while.

suscripcion.pruebaPorVencer: Your trial ends on {dia}. Contact J Solutions to keep using the app.
suscripcion.porVencer: Your subscription expires on {dia}. Contact J Solutions to renew it.
suscripcion.gracia: Your subscription expired on {dia}. You have until {hasta} to renew it; after that the app becomes read-only.
suscripcion.soloLectura: Your subscription expired on {dia}. The app is read-only: you can see and download everything, but can't save changes. Contact J Solutions to renew it.
suscripcion.soloLecturaPm: The app is read-only: changes can't be saved. Let the administrator know.

suspendida.texto: {empresa}'s account is suspended, so for now no one from the company can sign in. The administrator should contact J Solutions.
suspendida.datos: Your data is still saved: nothing was deleted.

plataforma.nuevaAyuda: Set up the company with its owner. When done, you'll get the link for the owner to sign in from their phone (valid 7 days, once).
plataforma.venceElAyuda: Empty: never expires. The owner is warned 7 days before; after it expires there are 7 grace days, then the app becomes read-only.
plataforma.uso: {pms, plural, one {# PM} other {# PMs}} · {obras, plural, one {# active job} other {# active jobs}}
plataforma.obrasTotal: {n, plural, one {# job in total} other {# jobs in total}}
plataforma.cubreHastaAyuda: Already calculated with its billing, from its due date (or from today if it already expired). You can change it.
plataforma.reinvitarAyuda: If the owner can't sign in. Cancels the invitations they didn't use.
plataforma.suspenderSeguro: No one from the company will be able to sign in until you reactivate it. Its data isn't deleted.
plataforma.celularAyuda: They sign in to the app with their cell number. No message is sent to it: you send them the link.
plataforma.celularEditarAyuda: They sign in with their cell. If you change it, the old one is freed.

cerrarObra.intro: When you deliver it, close it: its final numbers and what each stage cost per sq ft are saved, to learn how to quote. Once closed, it can't be edited.
cerrarObra.sinPendientes: Nothing is missing: the job is ready to close.

avisos.falta_cobrar: {monto} still to collect from the client.
avisos.oc_sin_responder: {n, plural, one {# change order without the client's answer.} other {# change orders without the client's answer.}}
avisos.oc_sin_facturar: {n, plural, one {# approved change order not collected.} other {# approved change orders not collected.}}
avisos.partidas_sin_terminar: {n, plural, one {# unfinished task: finish it, or remove it if it wasn't done on this job.} other {# unfinished tasks: finish them, or remove them if they weren't done on this job.}}
avisos.ot_sin_aprobar: {n, plural, one {# work order the PM didn't approve.} other {# work orders the PM didn't approve.}}
avisos.punch_abiertos: {n, plural, one {# open punch list item.} other {# open punch list items.}}
avisos.gastos_sin_recibo: {n, plural, one {# expense without a receipt photo.} other {# expenses without a receipt photo.}}
avisos.sin_presupuesto: No budget by stage: estimate accuracy can't be measured.
avisos.costos_sin_partida: {n, plural, one {# cost without a task: it isn't counted in any stage.} other {# costs without a task: they aren't counted in any stage.}}

cerrarObra.ayuda: The job days are counted to the delivery date, and the warranty starts then.
cerrarObra.confirmar: Something serious is missing (above). Close it anyway?
cerrarObra.cerrada: Job closed. Its summary and history were saved.
cerrarObra.sinArrancar: The job hasn't started yet: it can't be closed.

historico.sinObras: No closed jobs yet. When you deliver a job, close it from its follow-up ("Close the job") and its numbers will show up here.
historico.contexto: {n, plural, one {# closed job} other {# closed jobs}}. Simple averages: each job counts the same.
historico.tendenciaAyuda: Under each figure: your last 3 jobs vs. the 3 before (green, better; red, worse).
historico.porUnidadAyuda: From your closed jobs. With 5 or more jobs of different sizes we can tell which part of each stage is fixed and which grows with size; that is where the suggested cost comes from.
historico.rango: {n, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}} · from {minimo} to {maximo}
historico.sinUnidad: No closed stages with their measurement yet.
historico.lineaGarantias: {reclamos, plural, =0 {No warranty claims} one {# warranty claim} other {# warranty claims}} ({costo}; {abiertos, plural, =0 {none open} one {# open} other {# open}}) · {resenas} of {entregas} clients left a review
historico.lineaObraGarantia: {reclamos, plural, =0 {No claims} one {# claim} other {# claims}} ({costo}) · {resena, select, si {left a review} other {no review}}
historico.sugerirFijo: Better to charge it fixed per space.
historico.sugerirPie2: Better to price it per sq ft.
historico.sugerirLineal: Better to price it per linear ft.
historico.faltanObras: {n, plural, one {With # closed job: 5 of different sizes are needed to tell which part is fixed.} other {With # closed jobs: 5 of different sizes are needed to tell which part is fixed.}}
historico.masMuevenAyuda: How much each stage cost goes up for every 10 more units of size.
historico.sinMueven: Not enough closed jobs of different sizes to tell yet.

retrabajos.intro: Rework is our own mistake that we pay for, like redoing a row of tile; it isn't a change order, which the client pays. A warranty claim is the client's complaint after delivery. Its cost shows in the indicators and in the job's closeout.
retrabajos.ayudaRetrabajo: Already done: enter what it cost and the days lost.
retrabajos.ayudaGarantia: It stays open until it's handled; then you enter what it cost.
retrabajos.garantiaAlEntregar: Warranty claims are recorded once the job is delivered.
retrabajos.ninguno: This job has no rework or warranty claims.
retrabajos.diasPerdidos: {n, plural, one {# day lost} other {# days lost}}

posventa.intro: What's left with delivered jobs: open warranty claims and reviews to request.

pasos.autoriza_fotos: Allowed us to use the photos

posventa.ayudaPasos: If the client declined, mark it "No": it is settled and stops showing in your pending list.

semanaCuadrilla.ayuda: Tap a name to see which jobs and days they worked.
semanaCuadrilla.nadie: No one on the crew has hours logged this week.
